rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for anything that remains after other things have been removed.

example.english: I donated the residue after clearing the room.
example.traditional: 執完間房，剩低嘅嘢我都捐咗畀人。
example.jyutping: zap1 jyun4 gaan1 fong4 zing6 dai1 ge3 je5 ngo5 dou1 gyun1 zo2 bei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for solid or unwanted material left after a physical process such as filtering or distilling.

example.english: There was still some residue on the strainer after filtering the tea.
example.traditional: 濾完啲茶，隔網上面仲有啲殘渣。
example.jyutping: leoi6 jyun4 di1 caa4 gaak3 mong5 soeng6 min6 zung6 jau5 di1 caan4 zaa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the mathematical remainder after division.

example.english: When seven is divided by three, the residue is one.
example.jyutping: cat1 ceoi4 ji5 saam1 jyu4 sou3 hai6 jat1
